# Integration Benchmark

Comparison of integration methods using the scib-metrics framework
(Luecken et al. 2022, *Nature Methods*). Methods evaluated: Unintegrated,
Harmony, Scanorama, scVI.

Scoring weights: **40% batch removal + 60% bio conservation**.

## Setup

```{r libs, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(patchwork)
library(pheatmap)

theme_set(theme_classic())
```

```{r load-config}
config_path <- here::here(
  "chapter_2_sc_deconv_benchmarking", "01_sc_matrix",
  "scripts", "02_sc_integration_matrix", "config_integration.R"
)
source(config_path)
```

## 1. Aggregate scores

```{r aggregate-scores}
# overall = 0.4 * batch_removal + 0.6 * bio_conservation
scores_path <- file.path(benchmark_output_dir, "scib_scores.csv")
scores <- read.csv(scores_path)
scores
```

```{r plot-aggregate}
scores |>
  pivot_longer(-method, names_to = "component", values_to = "score") |>
  mutate(component = factor(component,
                            levels = c("overall", "batch_removal", "bio_conservation"))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(method, score), y = score, fill = component)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Overall integration scores",
       x = NULL, y = "Score (0-1)", fill = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    overall          = "#2C6E91",
    batch_removal    = "#E07B39",
    bio_conservation = "#4CAF50"
  ))
```

## 2. Per-metric breakdown

```{r per-metric}
metrics_path <- file.path(benchmark_output_dir, "scib_metrics.csv")
metrics <- read.csv(metrics_path)
metrics
```

```{r heatmap-metrics}
metrics_mat <- metrics |>
  column_to_rownames("method") |>
  as.matrix()

pheatmap(
  metrics_mat,
  cluster_rows  = TRUE,
  cluster_cols  = FALSE,
  display_numbers = TRUE,
  number_format = "%.2f",
  main  = "scib metrics per method",
  color = colorRampPalette(c("#F7F7F7", "#2C6E91"))(50)
)
```

## 3. UMAPs

```{r show-umaps, results='asis'}
umap_files <- list.files(benchmark_output_dir, pattern = "^umap_.*\\.png$",
                         full.names = TRUE)
cat("UMAP files found:", length(umap_files), "\n")

for (f in umap_files) {
  method_name <- gsub("umap_|\\.png", "", basename(f))
  cat(sprintf("\n### %s\n\n", method_name))
  cat(sprintf("![](%s)\n\n", f))
}
```
